_doc: Hunter spec models. shares = fraction of total damage from each source (Classic parse/spreadsheet intuition, stated so it can be argued with). tags decide which talent effects apply. base = crit per source type by gear tier. stat_to_* convert +1% stat to +dps/sustain/surv fractions. mana_share = fraction of mana spent on sources with that tag (for mana-cost talents). time overrides the profile's fight/downtime/death split. mana_weight per model overrides the raid profile's mana weight for mana-bound specs; pet_dmg_to_surv turns pet damage into pet threat (fewer hits on you); profile_overrides changes a source per profile. min_level/max_level are Classic learn levels (Forever unlock levels are a beta check).

bm-leveling.note: Pet-first leveling. Pet ~35-40% of damage in Classic BM leveling, Auto Shot ~40%, the rest instant shots and Serpent Sting. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Multi-Shot is a single rank (learned 18, 0.5s cast, 6s cooldown shared with Aimed Shot, no flat bonus), Aimed Shot 2s cast with +20..166 by rank, Arcane Shot 20..217, Serpent Sting 10..555; Raptor Strike 6s and Mongoose Bite 5s cooldowns. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, beta client 1.60.1.70291, build opt-bm-leveling-leveling-aoe at level 60, 1500 fights): shares are the measured damage split (Cat melee 24%, Auto Shot 22%, Serpent Sting 17%, Melee 16%, Volley 10%, Claw 5%, Mongoose Bite 2%, Summon Hawk 1%, Bite 1%, Aimed Shot 1%, Raptor Strike 0%, Wing Clip 0%) and the leveling time split is fight 66% / drink 5% / eat 5% / other 0% / death 24% of talent-affected time with fight_coupling 1.0 (downtime and deaths scale with fight length).
bm-leveling.kind_note: Pet-tank playstyle while leveling: the pet holds the mob, so kiting tools add nothing in single-target play (fight lab, 2026-09-27: Improved Wing Clip -0.2% +- 0.3 and Scatter Shot 0.0% in the pet hunter's loop at 60). Pulls of several mobs (leveling-aoe) keep them: adds come to the hunter.

mm-raid.note: Marksmanship raid DPS with a pet (Classic 20/31/0 style). Auto Shot ~45%, Aimed/Multi ~25%, pet ~18%. Aimed Shot/Sniper Shot are modelled as damage effects on the ranged sources, not as a source. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Multi-Shot lost its flat +150 and Aimed Shot's rank 6 is +166 (Classic +600) while Arcane Shot rank 8 rose to 217 (Classic 183): Multi-Shot share 16 -> 12%, Arcane Shot 4 -> 7%, Auto Shot 55 -> 58%, pet 18 -> 16%; Multi-Shot cooldown 6s (shared with Aimed Shot). Raid sim shares (2026-10-03, bm-mm-raid in the ElliotWood/Forever simulator b0f0df3, every mana-only buff on: the split before the mana limit): auto 46%, serpent 22%, pet 16%, aimed 14%, multi 2%; 24% of the damage matched no source. Fight lab speed (2026-10-17): its leveling build kills 0.98x as fast as bm-leveling's optimizer build (level-weighted time per kill 25.6s vs 25.1s), written as abs_dps_factor so respec.py compares the models on that.

sources.note: Aimed Shot / Sniper Shot: 23% of a Marksman's damage in the community simulator (2026-09-26); share fitted by raidsim/calibrate.py

mm-raid.kind_note: Pet-tank playstyle while leveling: the pet holds the mob, so kiting tools add nothing in single-target play (fight lab, 2026-09-27: Improved Wing Clip -0.2% +- 0.3 and Scatter Shot 0.0% in the pet hunter's loop at 60). Pulls of several mobs (leveling-aoe) keep them: adds come to the hunter.

forever.note: Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, training dummy): the builds lose 11-23% of their damage to mana (the same builds gain that much with every mana-only buff on); the mana-bound damage (every source but white attacks and pets) shrinks by min(cap, max(0, loss - (sustain - 1))), loss and cap fitted to those deficits and to the removal runs of the pure mana talents (the same build with less mana), the mana talents' sustain to their removal runs. Re-run the calibration instead of editing.

mm-lonewolf-raid.note: Marksmanship without a pet (Forever Lone Wolf). Same shot mix, pet share redistributed; sources carry the lonewolf tag so Lone Wolf applies and pet talents/Focused Fire do not. Aimed Shot/Sniper Shot are modelled as damage effects on the ranged sources, not as a source. Beta client 1.60.1.70009 (2026-09-25 refresh, see <class>/spells/README.md): Same beta adjustments as mm-raid: Multi-Shot 20 -> 15%, Arcane Shot 5 -> 8%, Auto Shot 67 -> 69%; Multi-Shot cooldown 6s. Raid sim shares (2026-10-03, mm-lone-wolf-raid in the ElliotWood/Forever simulator b0f0df3, every mana-only buff on: the split before the mana limit): auto 42%, serpent 21%, arcane 20%, aimed 17%; 0% of the damage matched no source.

sources.note: Aimed Shot / Sniper Shot: 23% of a Marksman's damage in the community simulator (2026-09-26); share fitted by raidsim/calibrate.py

Re-run the calibration instead of editing.

melee-dps.note: Melee hunter (Forever): dual-wield white swings under Aspect of the Beast, Raptor Strike on the next swing, Mongoose Bite after dodges and Expose Prey procs, Strider Kick on cooldown, Counterattack after parries, the Lacerating Strikes bleed, one Serpent Sting from the pull (the 8 yd minimum range stops every other shot in melee), and the pet unless Lone Wolf. Shares are 2026-09-27 assumptions from the tooltips (a 1.0 s weapon pair, Raptor Strike every 6 s, Mongoose Bite every ~8 s with Expose Prey, Strider Kick every 8 s) until the fight lab's melee rotation calibrates them. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, beta client 1.60.1.70291, build cand-melee-pet at level 60, 1500 fights): shares are the measured damage split (Cat melee 22%, Immolation Trap 15%, Raptor Strike 13%, Melee (off-hand) 12%, Melee 12%, Strider Kick 8%, Claw 6%, Mongoose Bite 5%, Auto Shot 5%, Bite 2%, Lacerate 0%, Counterattack 0%) and the leveling time split is fight 83% / drink 8% / eat 4% / other 0% / death 5% of talent-affected time with fight_coupling 0.0 (downtime and deaths scale with fight length). Fight lab speed (2026-10-17): its leveling build kills 1.03x as fast as bm-leveling's optimizer build (level-weighted time per kill 24.3s vs 25.1s), written as abs_dps_factor so respec.py compares the models on that.

sources.note: The Lacerating Strikes bleed: 40% of each Mongoose Bite over 21 s.

After a parry: 50% weapon damage plus 13 and a 5 s root, 5 s cooldown. Solo only: in a raid the melee hunter stands behind the boss, is never attacked and never parries, so the raid profiles give it no share.

melee-dps.kind_note: Melee playstyle: it fights in melee range and never kites, so roots and slows used to open distance (kite) and longer spell or shot range (range) are worth nothing to it in any scenario. Snares that stop a runner (stick), stuns and movement still count.

pet_tank.note: Fight lab 2026-09-27: without the pet (Lone Wolf) the melee hunter takes every hit and its downtime per kill grows from 2.8 to 7.1 s at 50 and from 3.7 to 7.4 s at 60 (x2.0-2.5; no deaths either way): downtime x1/(1-0.55) = x2.2 when no pet is out.
